placeholder.tags: Type a tag and press Enter...

tooltip.appCode: Unique identifier of the app across the whole platform, upper snake case. e.g. FTM, HRM_EM.
tooltip.metadata: Extended JSON information with no fixed schema.

validation.appCodeFormat: App code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. FTM, HRM_EM.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete app
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this app from the Registry? This action cannot be undone.

tooltip.serviceCode: Unique identifier of the service across the whole platform, upper snake case. e.g. HRM_EM, FLEET_MNG.
tooltip.metadata: Extended JSON information with no fixed schema.

validation.serviceCodeFormat: Service code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. HRM_EM, FLEET_MNG.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete service
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to delete this service from the Registry? All of its domains, resources and actions will be deleted too. This action cannot be undone.

deleteBlocked.title: Cannot delete service
deleteBlocked.description: This service is assigned to apps. Unassign it from those apps before deleting.

tooltip.serviceId: The Service that owns this domain. Only Active services are shown for selection.
tooltip.domainCode: Unique identifier of the domain within the selected Service, upper snake case. e.g. FUEL_ENTRY, EMPLOYEE.

validation.domainCodeFormat: Domain code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. FUEL_ENTRY, EMPLOYEE.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete domain
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to delete this domain from the Registry? All of its resources and actions will be deleted too. This action cannot be undone.

tooltip.domainId: The Domain that owns this resource.
tooltip.resourceCode: Unique identifier of the resource within the selected Domain, upper snake case. Used in the cross-service reference standard. e.g. EMPLOYEE, VEHICLE.
tooltip.actions: Actions of this resource, uppercase joined by underscores (e.g. VIEW, EXPORT_EXCEL). Each action generates a permission code <ServiceCode>.<DomainCode>.<ResourceCode>.<Action>.

validation.resourceCodeFormat: Resource code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. EMPLOYEE, VEHICLE.
validation.actionFormat: Action must be uppercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. E.g. VIEW, EXPORT_EXCEL.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete resource
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to delete this resource from the Registry? All of its actions (permission codes) will be deleted too. This action cannot be undone.

placeholder.actions: Pick or type an action, then Enter...

permissionCodes.title: Generated permission codes
permissionCodes.description: IAM syncs exactly these codes from PLM.
permissionCodes.empty: This resource has no actions yet.

unassignConfirm.title: Unassign
unassignConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this app-service link?

tooltip.role: Primary: the main service of the app — users see the app when they hold a permission of a Primary service. Dependency: a service the app calls.

changeRoleConfirm.title: Change service role
changeRoleConfirm.description: The Primary role decides whether the app is visible to users. Are you sure you want to change the role of this link?

structure.title: Service Structure
structure.emptySelection: Select a Service, Domain or Resource on the left to view details, or click "+" to add a new one.

deleteImpact.none: No child data will be deleted.
deleteImpact.hasMappings: This service is assigned to {count, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}} and cannot be deleted (SERVICE_HAS_MAPPINGS).

export.title: Export
export.currentRequired: Select a Service/Domain/Resource in the tree

import.title: Import
import.formatHint: A .txt file with one <ServiceCode>.<DomainCode>.<ResourceCode>.<Action> code per line. Blank lines are ignored. Import only adds missing Services/Domains/Resources/Actions; it never updates or deletes existing data.
import.hasErrors: The file has invalid lines. Fix or remove them, then pick the file again.
import.fileTooLarge: Import file must be at most 1 MB.

report.title: Import result
report.notApplied: The file has errors, so nothing was written.
